research_family: System-1 Language within six TAC families

source.original_manifest: TAC-LANG-GATE-003 source PROTOCOL.json; verify all 36 genuine Vim9.1 chapter SHA256s
source.fit_query_training: First 16 of the archived ordered 30 FIT chapters
source.independent_test: NOT TOUCHED; six Python 3.13 files from GRAPH009 already examined, NOT a new independent test

model.query: three-character encoded context normalized 16D; top-8 nonexact matches
model.source_causality: observed candidate continuation index strictly smaller than current query ordinal
model.exact_hit_policy: GRAPH009 unchanged; learned approximate retrieval ONLY for exact-key miss
model.query_training: FIT-only supervised contrastive loss: logsumexp(eligible candidates)-logsumexp(eligible same-next-byte positive candidates)
model.gradient_coverage_requirement: report positive-evidence fraction; zero-evidence examples give no claimed training signal
model.fusion: fixed GRAPH009 lambda=0.6, tau=0.05; query must abstain when no eligible neighbor

training.fit_window_sampler: sample source document with weight proportional to number of eligible 129-byte windows, then uniformly choose offset
training.checkpoint: persist learned model, optimizer, random generators, source SHA, sample-order SHA, protocol and cold-reload metrics per seed

controls: GRAPH009 exact-three-gram count only with identical owner/capacity/smoothing/prior
untrained seed-matched 2816-parameter approximate query with same topK, cache and fusion
learned 2816-parameter query enabled only on exact misses
metrics: effective cache event count and query time
success_gate: Learned better than untrained same-geometry and exact-only count baseline on overall FIT-validation NLL, with no negative performance on exact hits and positive value on exact misses in >=4/5 seeds; then freeze for a new external source before any independent claim.
caveats: This is approximate context matching for a tiny character model, not proof of semantic understanding.
Extra source event cache and query FLOPs must be counted, including when attached to matched SSM.
Model-only parameter parity does not equal end-to-end memory or compute parity.
Do not claim real external evaluation, new training or checkpoint replay until executed.
